title: I Spent 100 Days in RuneScape Dragonwilds Scorned Wilderness... Here's What Happened!
author: Rised
description:
This is the continuation of my journey through RuneScape Dragonwilds post 1.0 launch. I took on the Scorned Wilderness! I battled dragons and plenty of other interesting/dangerous creatures along the way! 

SUBSCRIBE HERE - @RisedGaming 

00:00 100 Days Intro
00:30 Scorned Wilderness Cinematic
02:55 Rasthin's Rest
04:05 Dragontail Vines
19:52 Fragments of Ghornfell
35:12 Ancestral Gear Upgrade
40:25 Shattered Stronghold
46:59 Cataclysm Keep
58:34 Kuldra Boss Fight
1:02:40 Kuldra Phase 2
1:09:12 Kuldra Phase 3
1:16:17 Kuldra Final Phase
1:19:07 Rewards & Ending


#100days  #runescape  #runescapedragonwilds  #dragonwilds  #survivalgame  #kuldra  #scornedwilderness
